title: Inessive forms before singular nouns
summary: Match tässä, tuossa, or siinä with a supplied singular inessive noun.
objectives: Place a singular inessive demonstrative before its noun.
Match singular number and inessive case.
Leave the supplied noun form unchanged.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: Before a singular inessive noun, use the matching singular demonstrative form: tässä kirjassa, tuossa laukussa, siinä talossa.
Both words express singular number and the inessive relation.

sections.title: Use one clear decision
paragraphs: The complete noun form is supplied because noun-case formation is not the target.
Choose only the demonstrative form that matches reference and agreement.

examples.english: The key is in this bag.
steps: tässä: learned inessive form of tämä.
laukussa: the complete non-target noun form is supplied.

examples.english: The book is in that bag over there.
steps: tuossa: learned inessive form of tuo.
laukussa: the complete non-target noun form is supplied.

examples.english: The key is in that car.
steps: siinä: learned inessive form of se.
autossa: the complete non-target noun form is supplied.

commonMistakes: Do not use nominative tämä before an inessive noun.
Do not use plural näissä with a singular noun.
Do not alter the supplied noun ending.

Correct. Tässä matches autossa in inessive case and singular number.
“tämä” is a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker; use “tässä”, the singular inessive form linked to tämä.
“tuossa” is the singular inessive form linked to tuo; use “tässä”, the singular inessive form linked to tämä.
“Kirja on tässä autoissa.” changes the supplied form or word order. The required sentence is “Kirja on tässä autossa.”: Tässä matches autossa in inessive case and singular number.
